extracted.intended_audience: authors, trialists, and journal editors reporting randomized trials (and peer reviewers/readers who appraise them)
extracted.subtask_short: reporting randomized trial protocols and results
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and reporting randomized trial protocols and trial results to ensure complete, transparent, and interpretable reporting using the SPIRIT and CONSORT statements and associated resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT Statement (Standard Protocol Items: Recommendations for Interventional Trials)
rubrics_metrics.description: The SPIRIT Statement is a minimum set of recommendations for reporting the protocol of a randomised trial. The recommendations are outlined in a 34-item checklist and a figure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the SPIRIT checklist (34 items) and figure when preparing trial protocols. The site strongly recommends using the SPIRIT Statement in conjunction with the 'Explanation and Elaboration' document, which explains and illustrates the principles underlying the SPIRIT Statement. Aim to report protocols completely and transparently so readers can critically appraise, interpret, and use the research.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Statement (CONsolidated Standards Of Reporting Trials)
rubrics_metrics.description: The CONSORT Statement is an evidence-based, minimum set of recommendations for reporting the results of randomised trials. The recommendations are outlined in a 30-item checklist and a flow diagram.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reporting trial results, follow the CONSORT 30-item checklist and flow diagram. The checklist items focus on reporting how the trial was designed, analysed, and interpreted; the flow diagram displays the progress of all participants through the trial. The site strongly recommends using the CONSORT Statement together with its 'Explanation and Elaboration' document for detailed guidance and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete and transparent reporting to enable appraisal and use
rubrics_metrics.description: The SPIRIT–CONSORT guidelines offer a standard way to report trial protocols and findings to help authors report their trials completely and transparently.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The objective of applying these guidelines is to provide readers with all the information they need to critically appraise, interpret, and use the research. This is an overarching quality standard that should guide inclusion of all relevant methodological, analytical, and result-related details in protocols and reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: SEPTRE (SPIRIT Electronic Protocol Tool & Resource)
rubrics_metrics.description: SEPTRE is an online tool that allows you to create, register, and manage trial protocols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SEPTRE is presented as a practical resource to support compliance with SPIRIT protocol items by facilitating creation, registration, and management of protocols. (Link provided on site for access and more information.)

rubrics_metrics.name: COBWEB (COnsort-Based WEB tool)
rubrics_metrics.description: COBWEB is an online writing aid tool that helps you to write, edit, share and export a randomised trial report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: COBWEB is offered as a tool to assist authors in preparing trial reports in line with CONSORT recommendations by supporting drafting, editing, collaboration, and export of reports. (Link provided on site for access and more information.)
